senses.en: worried; eager
Very eager to do something or for something to happen.

ex.en: She felt anxious before the test.
ex.zh: 考试前她感到焦虑。

ex.en: Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
ex.zh: 学校不提供职业指导时，学生可能会对未来感到焦虑。

tip: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。

senses.en: a light silver metal

ex.en: Aluminium cans go into the blue bin.
ex.zh: 铝罐放进蓝色回收箱。

ex.en: The frame is aluminium, so it is light enough for one person to carry upstairs.
ex.zh: 框架是铝的，轻得一个人就能扛上楼。

tip: 英式拼写 aluminium，五个音节。美式 aluminum 少一个 i，不在本库，不另开词头。
note: 英式 aluminium。美式 aluminum 不是本考纲这条词头。

senses.en: a hand with the fingers closed tightly

ex.en: He knocked on the door with his fist.
ex.zh: 他用拳头敲门。

ex.en: She opened her fist and showed the key she had been holding through the whole speech.
ex.zh: 她张开拳头，露出演讲全程一直握着的那把钥匙。

tip: 拳头是 fist。首先是 first。只差一个字母。

senses.en: to pay someone for a loss, or to balance a weakness

ex.en: The shop will compensate her for the broken lamp.
ex.zh: 商店会赔偿她打碎的灯。

ex.en: Extra practice can compensate for a slow start, if you keep the same plan every week.
ex.zh: 要是每周都按同一个计划练，额外练习能弥补起步慢。

tip: compensate sb for a loss 是赔偿。compensate for a weakness 是弥补。名词 compensation。

senses.en: to give time or energy to

ex.en: She will devote more time to study.
ex.zh: 她将把更多时间用于学习。

ex.en: Governments should devote more resources to preventive healthcare rather than relying entirely on expensive medical treatments.
ex.zh: 政府应将更多资源投入预防性医疗，而不是完全依赖昂贵的医学治疗。

tip: devote…to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to change to fit a new situation
to change something for a different use or audience

ex.en: Animals must adapt to climate change.
ex.zh: 动物必须适应气候变化。

ex.en: Schools must adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of students from diverse cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 学校必须调整教学方法，以满足不同文化背景学生的需求。

col: adapt teaching methods｜调整教学方法
adapt a novel for television｜把小说改编成电视剧
tip: adapt to后接名词或动名词；勿混adopt（采用）。

senses.en: a border, or the edge of what is known

ex.en: The town sits on the frontier between two regions.
ex.zh: 小镇坐落在两个地区的边界上。

ex.en: The article calls medical research a new frontier, full of questions we cannot answer yet.
ex.zh: 文章把医学研究称为新的前沿，里面满是我们还答不上的问题。

tip: 地理上是边境。引申义是某领域的前沿，常用 a new frontier。

senses.en: to burst with force, or to increase suddenly

ex.en: A sealed can may explode in a fire.
ex.zh: 密封罐在火里可能爆炸。

ex.en: The number of applications did not explode until the school posted the scholarship date.
ex.zh: 学校公布奖学金日期之后，申请数量才一下子多起来。

tip: 动词 explode，名词 explosion。本卡只讲安全和「突然变多」，不写制造爆炸物的方法。
note: 只收安全常识和「激增」义。

senses.en: easily broken or damaged

ex.en: These glasses are fragile, so pack them well.
ex.zh: 这些玻璃杯易碎，要包好。

ex.en: The fragile pages tore when we turned them, so the librarian brought cotton gloves.
ex.zh: 脆弱的书页一翻就裂，图书管理员便拿来了棉手套。

col: handle with care, fragile｜易碎，小心轻放
tip: 英式 fragile 常读成和 mile 押韵；美式末尾更像 /dʒəl/。意思都是易碎。

senses.en: a list of items, American spelling
to make a list of items

ex.en: The library catalog lists three copies.
ex.zh: 图书馆目录里列着三本。

ex.en: Search the catalog by the writer's family name if you do not know the full title.
ex.zh: 如果不知道完整书名，就按作者的姓在目录里查。

tip: 美式拼作 catalog。本批另有英式 catalogue，两条都能搜到。
note: 美式拼写。英式 catalogue 在本批另列。

senses.en: a person who directs musicians, or who sells tickets on a bus or train
a material that lets heat or electricity pass through

ex.en: The conductor raised the baton.
ex.zh: 指挥举起了指挥棒。

ex.en: Copper is a good conductor, so the lab uses it when the circuit will not close.
ex.zh: 铜是良导体，所以电路合不上时实验室用它。

col: a bus conductor｜公共汽车售票员
tip: conductor 可以是指挥、公共汽车售票员，也可以是物理里的导体。动词是 conduct。

senses.en: a small pack, or a block of data sent together

ex.en: Open one packet of seeds.
ex.zh: 打开一包种子。

ex.en: The lost packet of letters was under the bench, still tied with the red string.
ex.zh: 那包信落在长凳底下，红绳还系着。

col: a packet of biscuits｜一包饼干
a packet of data｜一个数据包
tip: 英式小包装常用 packet。美式常用 pack 或 package。数据包也是 packet。

senses.en: previous
being the first of two people or things just mentioned

ex.en: He is a former student of this school.
ex.zh: 他是这所学校以前的学生。

ex.en: Former industrial sites can be transformed into public parks, improving urban environments and creating shared spaces.
ex.zh: 昔日的工业用地可以改建为公园，从而改善城市环境并创造共享空间。

col: former industrial site｜昔日工业用地
tip: the former 指两者中的前者，the latter 指后者。

senses.en: the scientific study of stars, planets, and space

ex.en: Astronomy club meets on Thursdays.
ex.zh: 天文社团每周四活动。

ex.en: Astronomy asks how stars form, while astrology claims to read character from them, and the two are not the same.
ex.zh: 天文学研究恒星如何形成，占星术声称能从星象看性格，两者不是一回事。

tip: astronomy 是科学。astrology 是占星。astronomical 还可以形容数字大得惊人。

senses.en: easy to see or understand

ex.en: It is evident that she studied hard.
ex.zh: 很明显她学习很努力。

ex.en: The benefits of improved public transport are evident in cities where traffic congestion has decreased.
ex.zh: 在交通拥堵有所缓解的城市，改善公共交通的益处显而易见。

tip: 常用It is evident that...表示显然……。

senses.en: a room or building where students live

ex.en: Lights-out in the dorm is ten.
ex.zh: 宿舍十点熄灯。

ex.en: The dorm has a quiet floor during exams, and visitors sign the book at the door.
ex.zh: 考试期间宿舍有一层是安静楼层，来访者要在门口登记。

tip: dorm 是 dormitory 的口语缩略。正式作文可以写 dormitory。

senses.en: the main stem of a tree, or a large box

ex.en: We sat on the fallen trunk and ate lunch.
ex.zh: 我们坐在倒下的树干上吃午饭。

ex.en: The old trunk in the attic holds letters, and the lock still works.
ex.zh: 阁楼上的旧箱子里放着信，锁还能用。

tip: 参考表是树干和大箱子。象鼻也叫 trunk，本卡按表先记这两项。

senses.en: enough

ex.en: Food supply is adequate.
ex.zh: 食物供应是足够的。

ex.en: Schools need adequate funding to maintain safe buildings and provide effective support for students with additional needs.
ex.zh: 学校需要充足的资金来保障校舍安全，并为有额外需求的学生提供有效支持。

col: adequate for the task｜足以胜任任务
tip: 表示达到所需标准，不等于优秀；常接for或to。

senses.en: that you may choose, not required

ex.en: The afternoon club is optional.
ex.zh: 下午的社团是自愿参加的。

ex.en: Question six is optional, but a good answer there can still raise the final mark.
ex.zh: 第六题可选做，不过答得好仍然能提高最后的分数。

tip: optional 是可以不选。必修是 compulsory 或 required。

senses.en: to breathe out loudly because you are tired or sad
the sound of that breath

ex.en: She sighed and closed the heavy book.
ex.zh: 她叹了口气，合上那本厚书。

ex.en: A sigh went round the room when the final whistle ended the match in a draw.
ex.zh: 终场哨响、比赛踢平时，屋子里响起一片叹息。

tip: sigh 的 gh 不发音。with a sigh of relief 是松了口气。

senses.en: to speak very quietly
words spoken that way

ex.en: Whisper if the baby is asleep.
ex.zh: 宝宝睡了就小声说。

ex.en: A whisper at the back still reached the speaker, so he paused and asked for quiet.
ex.zh: 后排的低语还是传到了发言人那里，他停下来请大家安静。

tip: whisper to sb，不是 whisper sb。大喊是 yell 或 shout。

senses.en: a large building where goods are stored

ex.en: The new chairs are still in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 新椅子还在仓库里。

ex.en: A warehouse by the river stores the school's old desks until the summer sale.
ex.zh: 河边的一座仓库存放着学校的旧课桌，直到暑期义卖。

tip: warehouse 是存货的大房子。重音在前半，house 仍读 /haʊs/。

senses.en: tidy, or done in a clever simple way

ex.en: Keep the table neat so the next class can use it.
ex.zh: 把桌子保持整洁，下一班才能用。

ex.en: Her handwriting is neat, and the neat solution used only three lines.
ex.zh: 她的字迹整洁，那个巧妙的解法只用了三行。

tip: 参考表是整洁的、灵巧的。房间整洁和办法干净利落都可以说 neat。

senses.en: too painful, loud, or unpleasant to accept

ex.en: The heat felt unbearable.
ex.zh: 热得让人受不了。

ex.en: An unbearable noise from the drill stopped the quiz, and the class moved to the library.
ex.zh: 钻机的噪音让人受不了，测验停了，全班改去图书馆。

tip: unbearable 是无法忍受。反义 bearable。动词 bear 在这个意义上是忍受，过去分词 borne。

senses.en: a sudden event that causes great damage or suffering

ex.en: The flood was a catastrophe for the town.
ex.zh: 这场洪水对小镇是一场大灾难。

ex.en: Calling a missed bus a catastrophe wastes the word, which reporters keep for events that harm many people.
ex.zh: 把没赶上车叫大灾难是滥用这个词，记者把它留给伤害许多人的事件。

col: avoid a catastrophe｜避免一场大祸
tip: catastrophe 比普通的 problem 严重得多。形容词 catastrophic。写作时不要把小事说成灾难。

senses.en: a woman whose job is to clean and help in a house or hotel

ex.en: The maid folded towels in the hotel room.
ex.zh: 女仆在旅馆房间里叠毛巾。

ex.en: In the story the maid keeps the keys and knows which door sticks in wet weather.
ex.zh: 故事里女仆保管钥匙，并且知道哪扇门在潮湿天气会卡住。

tip: 这里是做家务的女仆。不要和 made（make 的过去式）看混。

senses.en: to pay to receive a magazine or service regularly

ex.en: You can subscribe on the library website.
ex.zh: 你可以在图书馆网站上订阅。

ex.en: The library subscribes to three science magazines and keeps them for one year.
ex.zh: 图书馆订阅三种科学杂志，保存一年。

tip: 参考表是订阅报刊。subscribe to sth。

senses.en: to clean or dry by rubbing

ex.en: Wipe the whiteboard before the next class.
ex.zh: 下一节课前把白板擦干净。

ex.en: Wipe your shoes on the mat, or the mud will mark the lab floor.
ex.zh: 在垫子上擦擦鞋，不然泥会弄脏实验室的地面。

col: wipe sth clean｜把某物擦干净
tip: wipe 是擦。扫地用 sweep，拖地用 mop。

senses.en: a group of singers, or the repeated part of a song

ex.en: The chorus sang the last part together.
ex.zh: 合唱队一起唱了最后一部分。

ex.en: Everyone joined the chorus, even students who had only hummed during the verses.
ex.zh: 副歌一到大家都加入了，连主歌时只哼哼的学生也唱了。

col: chorus of a song｜歌曲的副歌
tip: chorus 可以是合唱团，也可以是副歌。in chorus 是齐声。

senses.en: agreement among a group

ex.en: The class reached a consensus: no phones during the film.
ex.zh: 全班达成共识：看电影时不用手机。

ex.en: There is no consensus yet on whether the sports day should move to Friday.
ex.zh: 运动会要不要改到星期五，目前还没有一致意见。

tip: consensus 本身已含「共同」，不要再加 common 叠床架屋。前面常用 a。

senses.en: a woman in charge of a house, or a woman teacher

ex.en: The mistress of the house showed us the piano.
ex.zh: 女主人带我们看了那架钢琴。

ex.en: In the old novel the school mistress stayed late to help the younger class with reading.
ex.zh: 在那部旧小说里，女教师留到很晚，帮低年级练习阅读。

tip: 考纲里通常指女主人或女教师。女教师现在更常说 teacher。
note: 本卡只用考纲里的「女主人；女教师」。

senses.en: a large water bird with a long neck

ex.en: A goose blocked the path by the pond.
ex.zh: 一只鹅挡在池塘边的小路上。

ex.en: One goose stayed near the reeds while the rest of the flock swam toward the far bank.
ex.zh: 一只鹅留在芦苇附近，其余的游向了对岸。

tip: 复数是 geese，不是 gooses。a goose 是一只。

senses.en: a large fish with sharp teeth

ex.en: The film starts with a shark near the pier.
ex.zh: 电影开头是码头附近的一条鲨鱼。

ex.en: Shark fins on the menu started an argument in the biology club.
ex.zh: 菜单上的鱼翅在生物社里引起了一场争论。

tip: shark 是鲨鱼。口语里 shark 也可指骗子，参考表只写了鲨鱼。

senses.en: real

ex.en: The actual cost was higher.
ex.zh: 实际费用更高。

ex.en: Governments should measure the actual impact of transport policies rather than relying solely on predicted benefits.
ex.zh: 政府应衡量交通政策的实际影响，而不是仅仅依赖预期收益。

tip: actual指实际的，不等于表示目前的current。

senses.en: to end a law, system, or custom officially

ex.en: The school will abolish that fine.
ex.zh: 学校将取消那项罚款。

ex.en: Historians compare how different countries abolish an old rule, and the essay must cite the dates.
ex.zh: 历史学者比较不同国家如何废除一项旧规定，文章必须注明日期。

col: abolish a law｜废除一项法律
tip: abolish 的宾语是制度、法律或习俗，不是一个人。名词 abolition。

senses.en: a strong vehicle used on a farm for pulling

ex.en: The tractor left deep marks in the mud.
ex.zh: 拖拉机在泥里留下深深的痕迹。

ex.en: A red tractor pulled the cart of straw past the school gate just after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭刚过，一辆红色拖拉机拉着一车稻草经过校门口。

tip: tractor 是农用牵引车。司机仍说 driver，动词是 drive。

senses.en: to shout very loudly
a loud shout

ex.en: Please do not yell across the hall.
ex.zh: 请不要隔着大厅大喊。

ex.en: A yell from the stairs told us the bus had arrived, so we grabbed the bags and ran.
ex.zh: 楼梯上传来一声喊，说校车到了，我们抓起包就跑。

tip: yell at sb 是冲着某人喊，常常带怒气。声音很轻是 whisper。

senses.en: a mark left on the skin after a wound heals
to leave that kind of mark

ex.en: The scar on his knee is fading.
ex.zh: 他膝盖上的疤正在变淡。

ex.en: A deep cut may scar the skin, so the nurse cleaned it before she closed the file.
ex.zh: 深的伤口可能留下疤，护士先清洗，再合上记录。

col: a scar on the face｜脸上的疤
tip: scar 是伤好以后留下的印。正在流血的伤口是 wound 或 cut。

senses.en: the part of the body between the ribs and the hips

ex.en: The belt was loose around her waist.
ex.zh: 腰带在她腰上松松的。

ex.en: He tied the apron at the waist before he started washing the trays.
ex.zh: 他先把围裙系在腰上，再开始洗托盘。

tip: 腰是 waist。浪费是 waste，读音接近，拼写不同。

senses.en: a person who rides a bicycle

ex.en: A cyclist waited at the crossing.
ex.zh: 一个骑自行车的人在路口等着。

ex.en: Every cyclist on the school ride wears a helmet, and lights are required once the sky dims.
ex.zh: 学校骑行里的每个人都戴头盔，天色一暗还必须开车灯。

col: a racing cyclist｜自行车运动员
tip: cyclist 是骑车的人。自行车本身是 bicycle 或 bike。动词常用 cycle。

senses.en: the ability to do something well enough

ex.en: Language competence grows with use.
ex.zh: 语言能力随使用而增长。

ex.en: The test checks competence in reading and writing, not how fast a student can recite a list.
ex.zh: 这项测试看的是读写能力，不是学生背清单有多快。

tip: competence 不要和 competition（比赛）或 compete 弄混。形容词 competent。

senses.en: to move the head down and up to agree or greet
that movement

ex.en: Nod if you can hear the question.
ex.zh: 听得见问题就点头。

ex.en: She gave a nod to the conductor and then turned the page without a word.
ex.zh: 她对指挥点了一下头，然后一言不发地翻页。

col: a nod of agreement｜点头同意
tip: 点头同意是 nod。摇头是 shake one's head。过去式 nodded，双写 d。

senses.en: a solid with six equal square sides, or the result of multiplying a number by itself twice

ex.en: Each cube of ice went into a glass.
ex.zh: 每块冰都进了一个杯子。

ex.en: The cube of 3 is 27, which you can check by building a stack three blocks wide.
ex.zh: 3 的立方是 27，你可以搭一个三块宽的堆来核对。

col: a cube of sugar｜一块方糖
fam: cubed (adj. 立方的；切成方块的)
tip: 立方体和「某数的立方」都是 cube。形容词 cubic 本库另有一条。

senses.en: not awake, or done without realising

ex.en: The player was unconscious for a minute.
ex.zh: 那名队员昏迷了大约一分钟。

ex.en: An unconscious habit of tapping the desk annoyed the people sitting beside him.
ex.zh: 他无意识地敲桌子，惹恼了坐在旁边的人。

tip: 昏迷是 unconscious。无意识的习惯也用这个词。意识是 conscious。

senses.en: easy to see; seeming
Seeming to be true, though possibly not actually true.

ex.en: It was apparent that he was tired.
ex.zh: 很明显他累了。

ex.en: Despite the apparent benefits of remote learning, some students struggle without direct support from teachers.
ex.zh: 尽管远程学习看似有诸多好处，一些学生在缺乏教师直接帮助时仍感到吃力。

col: for no apparent reason｜无明显原因
tip: 可指“明显的”，也可指“看似的”，须看语境。

senses.en: to suffer or die because there is not enough food

ex.en: Do not starve yourself before a match.
ex.zh: 比赛前不要饿着肚子。

ex.en: Plants starve without light as surely as people starve without food, which the biology note puts side by side.
ex.zh: 植物没有光会衰竭，正如人没有食物会挨饿，生物笔记把两句放在一起。

tip: starve 可以指严重挨饿，口语 be starving 只是非常饿。不要鼓励节食到伤害身体。本批另有名词 starvation。

senses.en: to wish you had what someone else has
that feeling

ex.en: I do not envy his early bus.
ex.zh: 我不羡慕他那么早的班车。

ex.en: It is easy to envy a score, and harder to see the hours that sat behind it.
ex.zh: 羡慕一个分数很容易，看见分数背后的那些小时就难了。

col: envy sb sth｜羡慕某人某物
the envy of｜……所羡慕的对象
tip: envy sb sth。形容词是 envious，形容人；enviable 形容令人羡慕的事物。the envy of the class 是全班羡慕的对象。

senses.en: something you accept as true without proof

ex.en: The plan rests on one assumption: the bus will be on time.
ex.zh: 这个计划靠一个假定：公共汽车会准时。

ex.en: Her assumption that everyone had a laptop was wrong, so we shared three computers.
ex.zh: 她以为人人都有笔记本电脑，这个假定是错的，于是我们合用三台电脑。

tip: assumption 是名词。动词 assume 表示假定。

senses.en: a curved structure over an opening

ex.en: We met under the stone arch by the old gate.
ex.zh: 我们在旧门口的石拱下见面。

ex.en: The arch over the path is low, so the bus cannot pass and we walk the last minute.
ex.zh: 小路上的拱门很矮，公共汽车过不去，最后一分钟我们步行。

tip: arch 作名词是拱。architect 是建筑师，不是 arch 的一种形式。

senses.en: rubbish left in a public place
to leave rubbish around

ex.en: Pick up litter before you leave the park.
ex.zh: 离开公园前把垃圾捡起来。

ex.en: Papers litter the steps after a windy day, and the class clears them in pairs.
ex.zh: 大风过后纸片散落在台阶上，全班两人一组把它们清掉。

tip: litter 强调随地丢下的垃圾。垃圾箱是 a litter bin。动词 litter 是使某处布满杂物。

senses.en: to force liquid or food out of the mouth

ex.en: Spit seeds into a tissue, never onto the path.
ex.zh: 把籽吐进纸巾，不要吐在路上。

ex.en: He spat the bitter seeds into a tissue and threw that tissue into the bin by the door.
ex.zh: 他把苦籽吐进纸巾，再把纸巾扔进门口的垃圾桶。

col: spit on the ground｜随地吐痰
tip: 过去式是 spat。公共场所不要随地吐痰。本卡只收这个生活义，不写骂人的话。
note: 只收「吐」这个校园生活义。

senses.en: happening slowly
Rising or falling gently rather than steeply

ex.en: Progress is often gradual.
ex.zh: 进步往往是逐渐的。

ex.en: A gradual transition to renewable energy can help communities adapt without causing sudden job losses.
ex.zh: 逐步转向可再生能源有助于社区适应变化，避免就业岗位骤减。

tip: 强调变化缓慢、分阶段；副词形式为gradually。

senses.en: a political system based on public ownership

ex.en: The chapter explains socialism in plain words.
ex.zh: 这一章用平实的话解释社会主义。

ex.en: The history test asks how socialism is described in the textbook, not what you shout in class.
ex.zh: 历史考试问教科书怎样描述社会主义，不是问你在课堂上喊什么。

col: under socialism｜在社会主义制度下
tip: socialism 是名词。社会是 society。不要把两个词拼混。

senses.en: to bring goods in from another country

ex.en: The shop imports tea from Fujian every spring.
ex.zh: 这家店每年春天从福建进茶。

ex.en: Countries that import most of their grain watch the price of ships and fuel.
ex.zh: 粮食大多靠进口的国家，会盯着运费和燃料价格。

tip: 动词重音在后：import。名词「进口」重音在前。不要和 important 写成一个词。

senses.en: a class or meeting in which a small group discusses a subject

ex.en: The seminar starts with one question.
ex.zh: 讨论课从一个问题开始。

ex.en: Bring a printed page to the seminar, because the room has no screen this week.
ex.zh: 讨论课带一页打印稿，这个星期房间里没有屏幕。

col: a seminar on｜关于……的研讨会
tip: seminar 人少，大家讨论。面对很多人的演讲是 a lecture。

senses.en: a film or play based on another work
the process of getting used to something

ex.en: This play is an adaptation of a folk tale.
ex.zh: 这部戏是一篇民间故事的改编本。

ex.en: Her adaptation to the new timetable took several days, especially the early lab.
ex.zh: 她适应新课表花了几天，尤其是早实验。

col: an adaptation of a novel｜小说改编本
adaptation to a timetable｜适应课表
tip: 参考表两个意思都有：适应，改编本。动词是 adapt。

senses.en: a place to stay

ex.en: The school arranged accommodation for the visiting team.
ex.zh: 学校为来访的队伍安排了住宿。

ex.en: Cheap accommodation near the station was full, so we shared a room farther out.
ex.zh: 车站附近便宜的住处满了，于是我们在更远的地方合住一间。

tip: 英式常用不可数 accommodation。美式有时用 accommodations 表示住处。

senses.en: to suppose; to take on
To take on a duty, responsibility, or position.
To begin to have a particular appearance or quality.

ex.en: Don't assume that everyone knows the rules.
ex.zh: 不要假定人人都知道规则。

ex.en: Policymakers should not assume that all households have reliable internet access or adequate digital skills.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不应假定所有家庭都有稳定的网络连接或足够的数字技能。

tip: assume常接that从句，强调未经证实便认为。

senses.en: to take up; to take as one's own
To legally take someone else's child into your family.
To formally approve a proposal, policy, or rule.

ex.en: The school will adopt a new teaching method.
ex.zh: 学校将采用一种新的教学方法。

ex.en: Governments should adopt long-term strategies that improve public transport rather than simply building more roads.
ex.zh: 政府应采取改善公共交通的长期策略，而不是一味增建道路。

col: adopt an approach｜采用一种方法
adopt a policy｜采纳一项政策
tip: adopt是采用或收养；adapt是适应或改编。

senses.en: power to make decisions
an official body responsible for a particular area or service
a person with extensive knowledge of a particular subject

ex.en: The school authority made a new rule.
ex.zh: 学校当局制定了新规则。

ex.en: Local authorities should consult residents before introducing policies that significantly affect access to public services.
ex.zh: 地方当局在推出显著影响公共服务获取的政策前，应征求居民意见。

col: have authority to do something｜有权做某事
an authority on｜某方面的权威
tip: 表权力通常不可数；the authorities常指当局。

senses.en: a small piece of old cloth

ex.en: Wipe the bench with a dry rag.
ex.zh: 用一块干布把实验台擦一擦。

ex.en: The rag in the art room is for paint, not for the dishes, and it stays in the red box.
ex.zh: 美术教室里的破布是擦颜料的，不是洗碗的，它放在红盒子里。

tip: in rags 表示衣服破旧。rag 也可以是小报，那是另一义，本卡先讲布。

senses.en: something given to help
Money or goods given to support a person or cause.
A piece of writing supplied for a publication.

ex.en: His contribution to science was huge.
ex.zh: 他对科学的贡献巨大。

ex.en: Public libraries make a valuable contribution to lifelong learning by providing free access to information.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供信息资源，为终身学习作出了宝贵贡献。

col: make a contribution to｜为…作出贡献
tip: 常用make a contribution to；to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to write letters or emails to someone
to match or be similar to something

ex.en: We correspond by email once a month.
ex.zh: 我们每个月通一次电子邮件。

ex.en: These figures correspond to last year's table, so the rise is easy to see.
ex.zh: 这些数字和去年的表对应，所以上升很容易看出来。

tip: correspond with sb 是通信。correspond to sth 是与某事相符或对应。介词决定意思。

senses.en: to put something briefly into a liquid

ex.en: Dip the brush in water before you paint.
ex.zh: 上色前先把刷子在水里蘸一下。

ex.en: She would dip the cloth into warm water and then wipe the ink off the desk.
ex.zh: 她会把布在温水里浸一浸，再擦掉桌上的墨水。

col: dip into a book｜翻阅一本书
tip: dip 是短时间浸入再取出。长时间泡用 soak。

senses.en: to value or be thankful for
Recognise and enjoy the value or quality of something.
Understand the importance or difficulty of a situation.

ex.en: I really appreciate your help.
ex.zh: 我真心感激你的帮助。

ex.en: Policymakers need to appreciate the difficulties rural communities face when accessing healthcare and other essential services.
ex.zh: 政策制定者需要理解农村社区在获取医疗及其他基本服务时面临的困难。

col: appreciate your help｜感谢你的帮助
appreciate the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: 可接名词或动名词，不接to do；感谢帮助用appreciate your help。

senses.en: warm, comfortable, and pleasantly small

ex.en: The reading corner feels cozy.
ex.zh: 这个阅读角让人觉得舒服。

ex.en: A cozy cabin is pleasant in the rain, provided the stove is safe and the window can still open.
ex.zh: 下雨时小屋很温馨，只要炉子安全、窗户仍能打开。

col: cozy and warm｜又舒服又暖和
tip: cozy 是美式拼写。英式常写 cosy。它多形容地方，不形容一道难题。

senses.en: a small hotel, often in the country

ex.en: We stayed at a small inn near the station.
ex.zh: 我们住在车站附近的一家小旅店。

ex.en: The inn had only six rooms, and ours looked onto a noisy yard.
ex.zh: 这家小旅店只有六个房间，我们那间对着一个吵闹的院子。

col: stay at an inn｜住小旅店
tip: inn 是小旅馆。不要写成 in 或 inner。

senses.en: to say strongly that something is wrong, or to sentence someone

ex.en: The letter condemns wasting public water.
ex.zh: 这封信谴责浪费公共用水。

ex.en: Teachers condemn cheating, and they also explain how to quote a source honestly.
ex.zh: 老师谴责作弊，同时也讲怎样诚实地引用资料。

col: condemn a building｜宣布建筑不得使用
tip: condemn sb / sth for。名词 condemnation。宣布房屋危不得使用也可以用 condemn。

senses.en: correct and exact
able to hit or reach the intended target

ex.en: Give an accurate answer, please.
ex.zh: 请给出准确答案。

ex.en: Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 准确的空气质量信息能帮助居民在充分知情的情况下决定是否进行户外锻炼。

tip: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

senses.en: graceful and attractive in a simple way

ex.en: The black dress looks elegant and plain.
ex.zh: 那条黑裙子看着优雅又朴素。

ex.en: An elegant solution uses fewer steps, which is why the teacher praised that proof.
ex.zh: 优雅的解法步骤更少，所以老师夸了那个证明。

tip: elegant 可以形容衣着，也可以形容办法简洁漂亮。

senses.en: a person who makes and repairs wooden things

ex.en: A carpenter repaired the stage steps.
ex.zh: 一位木匠修好了舞台台阶。

ex.en: The carpenter measured the shelf twice, because the wall in the lab is not straight.
ex.zh: 木匠把搁板量了两次，因为实验室的墙不直。

tip: 木工活是 carpentry。carpenter 是做这行的人。

senses.en: not often

ex.en: She seldom misses a morning run.
ex.zh: 她很少错过晨跑。

ex.en: Seldom does the lab close on a weekday, so a locked door usually means a safety check is under way.
ex.zh: 实验室很少在工作日关门，所以门锁上通常表示正在做安全检查。

tip: seldom 放在句首时，后面要部分倒装：Seldom does he...。它的意思接近 rarely，和 often 相反。

senses.en: a unit of land area

ex.en: The school field covers about two acres.
ex.zh: 学校操场大约有两英亩。

ex.en: Farmers measured the field in acres long before the map showed metres and squares.
ex.zh: 早在地图用米和方格之前，农民就用英亩量这块地。

col: two acres of land｜两英亩地
tip: acre 是面积单位，大约 4047 平方米。不要和 eagle 看混。

senses.en: a French title for a married woman, or a polite form of address

ex.en: The letter opened with Madame Zhou.
ex.zh: 信的开头是「周夫人」。

ex.en: Call her Madame Curie in the science report, because that is the name on the source card.
ex.zh: 科学报告里称她居里夫人，因为资料卡上写的是这个名字。

tip: madame 是法语称呼，姓名前要大写：Madame Curie。英语 madam 仍在考纲里，Zipf 更低，本批不收。
note: 称呼用大写 Madame。只收尊称，不写其他义。

senses.en: to push someone strongly to do something
a strong wish

ex.en: I urge you to hand the form in today.
ex.zh: 我劝你今天就把表交上去。

ex.en: He felt a sudden urge to leave the noisy hall and finish the reading outside.
ex.zh: 他突然很想离开嘈杂的礼堂，到外面把阅读做完。

col: urge sb to do｜催促某人做
tip: urge sb to do sth。名词指一时压不住的冲动。

senses.en: done by choice, not because you must

ex.en: The evening rehearsal is voluntary.
ex.zh: 晚上的排练是自愿参加的。

ex.en: Voluntary work at the library counts, but it does not replace the written exam.
ex.zh: 图书馆的志愿工作算数，但不能代替笔试。

tip: voluntary 是自愿的。名词 volunteer 是志愿者。

senses.en: the feeling of needing a drink, or a strong wish
to want something very strongly

ex.en: Thirst woke him before dawn.
ex.zh: 渴在黎明前把他渴醒了。

ex.en: Her thirst for maps began in primary school, when one atlas filled a whole shelf at home.
ex.zh: 她对地图的渴望从小学就开始了，那时家里一整层架子都是一本地图册。

col: thirst for knowledge｜对知识的渴望
tip: 口渴是 thirst，形容词 thirsty。thirst for 表示对知识或成功的渴望。动词 thirst 不如名词常见。

senses.en: a belief about what will happen

ex.en: The teacher's expectation is a full draft by Monday.
ex.zh: 老师的期望是星期一交完整草稿。

ex.en: The result was below expectation, so the group met again and checked the scale.
ex.zh: 结果低于预期，于是小组又碰了一次头，核对了天平。

col: live up to expectations｜不负期望
tip: expectation 是名词。动词 expect。常用复数 expectations。

senses.en: happening in every part of the country

ex.en: The speech contest is nationwide, so our school can enter.
ex.zh: 演讲比赛是全国性的，我们学校可以参加。

ex.en: A nationwide search for the missing instrument ended when it turned up in a taxi.
ex.zh: 对那件失踪乐器的全国搜寻，在它出现在一辆出租车里时结束了。

tip: 参考表标成 ad.，中文是「全国范围内的」。本卡按形容词。它也可以作副词：sold nationwide。

senses.en: an Australian animal that jumps and carries its young in a pouch

ex.en: A kangaroo crossed the dirt road.
ex.zh: 一只袋鼠穿过了土路。

ex.en: The article explains that a young kangaroo stays in the pouch, and the photo shows only the mother's feet.
ex.zh: 文章说明小袋鼠待在育儿袋里，照片上只拍到了母亲的脚。

tip: kangaroo 复数是 kangaroos。幼崽待的袋子是 pouch。

senses.en: to run away from danger

ex.en: People flee the smoke instead of hiding in it.
ex.zh: 人要离开烟，不要躲在烟里。

ex.en: The villagers fled uphill when the river rose, and the school gym took them in.
ex.zh: 河水上涨时村民往山上撤，学校体育馆收留了他们。

tip: 过去式和过去分词是 fled。flee 强调离开危险。flight 还可以是航班，要看上下文。

senses.en: the right to act freely
The state of not experiencing something unpleasant.

ex.en: Speech freedom is valued in many places.
ex.zh: 许多地方重视言论自由。

ex.en: Universities should protect academic freedom while encouraging researchers to consider the social consequences of their work.
ex.zh: 大学应保护学术自由，同时鼓励研究人员考虑其工作的社会影响。

tip: freedom to do表示做某事的自由；from表示免受。

senses.en: a grain used to make flour and bread

ex.en: The field beyond the dorm is planted with wheat.
ex.zh: 宿舍那边的地种的是小麦。

ex.en: This region grows wheat, not rice, so the bread here is made from local flour.
ex.zh: 这个地区种小麦，不种水稻，所以这里的面包用本地面粉。

tip: wheat 是植物或谷粒。面粉是 flour。

senses.en: the main land mass, not the islands

ex.en: The ferry links the island to the mainland.
ex.zh: 渡船连接岛屿和大陆。

ex.en: Fruit from the mainland arrives on Thursdays, which is why the market is busiest then.
ex.zh: 大陆来的水果周四到，所以那天集市最挤。

tip: mainland 相对岛屿而言。前面常加 the。

senses.en: the part of a phone you hold to your ear

ex.en: Put the receiver down if nobody answers.
ex.zh: 如果没人接，就把听筒放下。

ex.en: The receiver was warm from the long call, and the cord barely reached the desk.
ex.zh: 打了很久，听筒是热的，线也勉强够到桌子。

col: pick up the receiver｜拿起听筒
a radio receiver｜无线电接收器
tip: 动词 receive 已在词库。receiver 也可指接收器，参考表这一行是电话听筒。

senses.en: governing itself, or able to act independently

ex.en: The club is autonomous inside the school.
ex.zh: 这个社团在校内是自主管理的。

ex.en: An autonomous region writes some local rules, while national law still covers the whole area.
ex.zh: 自治区可以制定部分地方规定，全国性法律仍然覆盖整个地区。

tip: 名词是 autonomy。autonomous learning 是自己安排的学习，不是离开学校。

senses.en: basic and important
A basic principle or skill, usually considered with others.

ex.en: Honesty is a fundamental value.
ex.zh: 诚实是基本价值观。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water is a fundamental requirement for improving public health in disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获得清洁饮用水是改善弱势社区公共卫生的基本条件。

tip: 名词通常用复数 fundamentals，表示基本原理。

senses.en: an instrument that makes far objects look nearer

ex.en: The night class uses the telescope fixed on the roof.
ex.zh: 夜课使用固定在屋顶上的望远镜。

ex.en: Through the telescope the moon's craters look sharp, even on a cold night.
ex.zh: 透过望远镜，即使在冷夜里，月球上的环形山也很清楚。

col: look through a telescope｜用望远镜看
fam: telescopic (adj. 望远镜的；可伸缩的)
tip: 望远镜是 telescope。显微镜是 microscope。不要对调。

senses.en: the regular beat of blood in the body

ex.en: The nurse checked my pulse after the race.
ex.zh: 赛后护士给我测了脉搏。

ex.en: His pulse was fast, so they made him sit in the shade before he ran again.
ex.zh: 他脉搏很快，于是他们让他在阴凉处坐下，然后再跑。

tip: 脉搏是 pulse。把手指放在手腕上数。参考表也写了光或波的脉动。

senses.en: a dry fruit with a hard shell

ex.en: Tell the cook if you cannot eat a nut.
ex.zh: 如果你不能吃坚果，告诉厨师。

ex.en: This bun has a nut in the middle, so it is not for the students with that allergy.
ex.zh: 这个面包中间有一颗坚果，有这种过敏的学生不能吃。

tip: 参考表是坚果、果仁。螺母也叫 nut，本卡不收。

senses.en: a bus or train that goes regularly between two places

ex.en: A shuttle runs from the station to the campus.
ex.zh: 有班车从车站开到校园。

ex.en: The evening shuttle stops at the gate, so you do not have to walk across the dark field.
ex.zh: 晚班车在门口停，你就不用穿过那片黑漆漆的场地。

tip: 两地之间来回开的车是 shuttle。航天飞机是 space shuttle。

senses.en: above your head
located above your head

ex.en: Birds flew overhead as we left the hall.
ex.zh: 我们离开礼堂时，鸟从头顶飞过。

ex.en: An overhead light flickered, and the librarian asked someone to change the tube.
ex.zh: 头顶的灯一闪一闪，图书管理员请人去换灯管。

tip: overhead 可作副词或形容词。经费里的日常开支也叫 overheads，那是另一义。

senses.en: a matter or event
a romantic relationship involving someone committed to another partner

ex.en: Public affair need careful attention.
ex.zh: 公共事务需要认真关注。

ex.en: Schools can encourage young people to take an interest in current affairs through regular discussions of global events.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过定期讨论全球事件，鼓励年轻人关注时事。

tip: 表公共事务常用复数affairs，如current affairs。

senses.en: to pay someone to work for you

ex.en: The shop will employ two more clerks.
ex.zh: 这家店还要雇两名店员。

ex.en: The factory does not employ children, and the notice by the gate says so plainly.
ex.zh: 工厂不雇用儿童，门口的告示写得很明白。

tip: employer 是雇主，employee 是雇员。就业是 employment。

senses.en: first
The first letter of a person's name
To mark a document with the first letters of your names

ex.en: My initial plan was wrong.
ex.zh: 我最初的计划是错的。

ex.en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.
ex.zh: 虽然太阳能电池板的初期费用较高，但从长远看，家庭可能节省开支。

tip: 形容词通常放在名词前；姓名首字母常用initials。

senses.en: a list of names, or a folder of files

ex.en: Her name is in the school directory.
ex.zh: 她的名字在学校名录里。

ex.en: Save the photos in a new directory so they do not mix with last year's files.
ex.zh: 把照片存进新目录，免得和去年的文件混在一起。

tip: 纸质名录和电脑里的文件夹都可以叫 directory。

senses.en: to state formally that you are leaving a job

ex.en: She will resign at the end of term.
ex.zh: 她学期结束时辞职。

ex.en: He chose not to resign, because the team still needed him for the last month.
ex.zh: 他决定不辞职，因为团队最后一个月还需要他。

tip: resign from 是辞职。resign yourself to 是无可奈何地接受，不是把事情交给别人。

senses.en: to act dishonestly, especially in a test
a person who cheats, or the act

ex.en: Nobody is allowed to cheat on the quiz.
ex.zh: 测验时谁也不许作弊。

ex.en: He tried to cheat by hiding notes in his sleeve, and the teacher saw the paper.
ex.zh: 他想把笔记藏在袖子里作弊，老师看见了那张纸。

col: cheat on a test｜考试作弊
cheat sb out of｜骗走某人的
tip: 考试作弊是 cheat on/in a test。名词 cheat 也可指作弊的人。

senses.en: of the region around the North Pole

ex.en: Arctic air reached the city, and the pond froze.
ex.zh: 北极冷空气到了这座城市，池塘结冰了。

ex.en: The Arctic fox in the documentary changes color when the snow comes.
ex.zh: 纪录片里的北极狐在下雪时会换毛色。

tip: 作专名时常大写：the Arctic。南极是 the Antarctic。

senses.en: a person paid to work in someone's house

ex.en: In the play, the servant hears the secret first.
ex.zh: 剧里，仆人最先听到那个秘密。

ex.en: The old house once kept a servant beside the kitchen, in a room now used for storage.
ex.zh: 这栋老房子从前在厨房旁边住着一个仆人，那间房现在用来堆东西。

tip: servant 是为人工作的人。civil servant 是公务员，不是家里的佣人。
